android.desc:
VoltSim is a realtime electronic circuit simulator like Multisim, SPICE, LTspice, Altium or Proto for circuit design with a better user experience.

VoltSim is a complete circuit app in which you can design circuit with various components and simulate an electric or digital circuit.

During simulation you can check voltage, current and many other variables. Check signals on multichannel oscilloscope or multimeter and tune your circuit in real time! You can also use VoltSim as logic circuit simulator and perform digital electronic analysis! This app will help you visualize how the voltage varies across the circuit and how current flows through it.

Voltsim is an electronic circuit simulator app with in-build logic circuit simulator and digital circuit simulator.

The examples provided with the app cover the basic functionality of all components.

Some app use-cases:
learn electronics
electronics circuit simulator
circuit simulator arduino (upcoming)
electric circuit simulator

You can report an issue or make component request at https://github.com/VoltSim/VoltSim/issues or just email us :)

Feature highlights:
* Material, intuitive user interface
* Unlimited workspace
* Animation of potential difference and current
* Automatic wire routing
* Manually adjust wire routing
* Automatic simulation
* Plot values in oscilloscope
* view values in multimeter
* Export circuits


Components:
+ Voltage sources (single and double terminal)
+ Current source
+ Resistor
+ Potentiometer
+ Capacitor (polarised and non-polarised)
+ Inductor (inductance)
+ Transformer
+ Diode 
+ Zener diode
+ Tunnel Diode
+ LED
+ Transistor (NPN, PNP)
+ Mosfet (n, p)
+ Switches (SPST, Push,  SPDT)
+ Operational amplifier
+ Voltmeter
+ Ammeter
+ ohmmeter
+ Fuse
+ Joint ( for creating cross joints in wire )
+ Text
+ Relay
+ Bulb
+ Digital gates (and, or, xor, nand, nor, xnor, not, logic in/out)
+ FlipFlops
+ 555 IC
+ schmitt trigger
+ ADC
+ DC Motor
+ SparkGap
+ Buzzer
+ Probe
+ OhmMeter
+ Speaker
+ LDR
+ Diac
+ oscillator
+ thyristor

Realtime Simulation: VoltSim offers realtime electronic circuit simulation, just like the industryleading tools Multisim, SPICE, LTspice, Altium, and Proto. Experience the magic of circuits coming to life as you build and test them.

UserFriendly Interface: Say goodbye to the steep learning curve! VoltSim provides a better user experience, making it accessible to beginners and experts alike. Y
